subject.title: [Feature]: Show session and requester context in macOS exec approval popup

question: Which requester metadata may the macOS native exec approval popup disclose beyond the existing session key, and what redaction or omission rules should apply to channel, account, thread, sender, and reason values?
rationale: The Session row is a narrow parity fix, but the requested channel/sender/requester fields can disclose private conversation context in a native OS popup and need maintainer-approved policy before implementation.

options.title: Stage Session First
options.body: Add the existing sessionKey display now and defer channel, sender, thread, account, and reason fields until a disclosure policy is approved.

options.title: Define full metadata policy first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers choose the exact fields and redaction behavior, then land the complete native-popup update together.

options.title: Limit scope to session only
options.body: Treat richer requester metadata as out of scope and close the broader portion after the Session row lands.

recommendation.title: Stage Session First
recommendation.body: Add the existing sessionKey display now and defer channel, sender, thread, account, and reason fields until a disclosure policy is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from prior review on this exact issue and repeated exec-approval/macOS approval history.
